envelope.text: and `default_string_array(&[&str])`; neither exists here, so pass the array

why:
the `&[&str]` convenience for the same thing; see `rust:ParameterBuilder::default_from_iter`. A string array here is `Vec<String<MAX_STRING_VALUE_LEN>, MAX_ARRAY_LEN>` -- two compile-time bounds, not a borrowed slice of unbounded strs.
